source.title: Rough Wolf Pelts
source.description: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
source.objective: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
